# legal-audit-eu

> Privacy-lawyer-grade EU/EEA/UK website audit skill for GDPR, ePrivacy/PECR, consumer rights, DSA, AI Act, accessibility, and security signals.

## About

legal-audit-eu is a Claude/Hermes-compatible skill repository for EU/EEA/UK website and web-app legal-engineering audits. It compares app reality against legal documents and guides article-aware review for GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy/PECR, international transfers, processors, RoPA, DPIA, DPO, EU/UK representative, ecommerce consumer rights, DSA/platform duties, AI Act triage, accessibility, and security-disclosure signals.
